title: רב אחא בר דליא

paragraphs: Rav Acha bar Delya (see there). Rav told him, Gittin 14a; Rav permitted him, Sukkah 26a. See Jerusalem Talmud, end of Haddar: people of bar Deli who do not mind, etc. Thus perhaps it is a place name (see Abba Kohen Bardela). Rav Acha Bardela told his son, Beitzah 14a.
